import json
from pathlib import Path

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

training_path = Path('results/training/qwen35_rloo.json')
guard_path = Path('results/training/qwen35_rloo_memory.json')
training = json.loads(training_path.read_text())
guard = json.loads(guard_path.read_text())
initial = Path('train/runs/qwen3.5-4b-sft/adapters.safetensors')
adapter = Path('train/runs/qwen3.5-4b-rloo/adapters.safetensors')
assert training['status'] == guard['status'] == 'completed'
assert len(training['history']) == 24 and guard['returncode'] == 0
assert file_sha256(initial) == training['initial_adapter_sha256']
assert file_sha256(adapter) != file_sha256(initial)
record = {
    'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'retain completed local RLOO trial before inspecting its policy validation'}, training['model_revision']),
    'source': Path(__file__).read_text(),
    'training_result': str(training_path), 'memory_result': str(guard_path),
    'input_sha256': {str(p): file_sha256(p) for p in (training_path, guard_path, initial, adapter)},
    'status': 'completed', 'groups': 24, 'categorical_completions_per_group': 4,
    'zero_advantage_groups': sum(not any(x['advantages']) for x in training['history']),
    'wall_seconds': training['wall_seconds'], 'guard_wall_seconds': guard['wall_seconds'],
    'mlx_allocated_peak_bytes': training['peak_memory_bytes'],
    'sampled_footprint_peak_bytes_approx': guard['sampled_footprint_peak_bytes_approx'],
    'adapter_sha256': file_sha256(adapter),
    'interpretation': 'Local REINFORCE with leave-one-out rewards, dice only, from the fixed SFT adapter. No PPO clipping, reference KL or critic; not TRL GRPO. Training rewards vary by state and are not a before/after policy-quality estimate. Registered validation and one selected held-out test remain pending.'}
Path('results/training/qwen35_rloo_completion.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({k: record[k] for k in ('status', 'groups', 'wall_seconds', 'adapter_sha256')}))
